detail.longDescription: Google's Gemini Decisions API runs a model called Gemini Decision 1 that returns calibrated probabilities instead of text. It scores up to 1,000 yes/no, choice and rubric questions against a shared input, for branching calls inside agents: routing, policy checks, tool selection and grading. Priced at 0.10 USD per 1M input tokens, no output tokens billed. https://www. marktechpost.com/2026/11/11/go ogle-gemini-decisions-api-gemini-decision-1/ # AIagent # AI # GenAI # AIresearch
